textSplitter.description:
The langchain splitter to use for text processing.
Only specific splitters are currently supported.

specType.description: The name of the TextSplitter spec type.

chunkSize.description:
The chunk size for the splitter.
The default set here is standard for the TokenTextSplitter splitter.

chunkOverlap.description:
The chunk overlap for the splitter.
The default set here is standard for the TokenTextSplitter splitter.

splitterModule.description:
The module used for the specific splitter.
This json would include name and the importPath of the splitter module.
Supported modules are:
1. langchain
2. custom
   (custom chunker should inherit from the TextSplitter class)

Importing from langchain directly requires extending the py-chunker runtime to include langchain,
as langchain was removed from the py-chunker runtime in release 5.0.

title:
Genai.SourceFile.TextSplitter.Spec defines the langchain splitter to use for text processing.
Also defines the chunk size and overlap for the splitter.
name: Genai.SourceFile.TextSplitter.Spec
